title: A user who cannot change the Bill To gets the invoiced toast with no button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work orders → View', 'Invoicing & payments → View' and 'See Financial Data' but not 'Work orders → Create & Edit', at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced (not paid), billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • An error toast shows "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed."
  • The toast has no button to go anywhere.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-N3: “Users who cannot change the Bill To get M1 or M4 as an error toast on click or tap, with no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Click" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build), "Phone, tap" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build), "Click" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build), "Click" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

  • bt-p3-12-after-phone-tap.png

The design's own words:

  • “Error toast: "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from 7 Star Truck Repair. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To." with "Close" only.”
  • “Details open, the Bill To field tapped (it sits below the fold, under the toast). The same toast, "Close" only. A tap never depends on a hover.”
  • “Error toast with the same words and "Go To Invoice" and "Close". "Go To Invoice" opens the Finance tab; it never reverses anything.”

Difference BT-D02 on S5-N3 (BT-D02): this case follows the PRD; the design's version is asked in question 5.
